Comment EBOOK and I'll send you the full Faceless AI Affiliate ebook. 🔒

Most people pick an offer in four minutes. Then they blame the algorithm for a year.

Ask three questions first:

1. Does it pay every month? Pay-once offers put you back at zero. Monthly ones keep paying.

2. Do you use it yourself? You can't show a tool you've never opened.

3. How long is the cookie? 30 days or more. Under 7 and you're working for free.

Pick three tools you already pay for. Read the terms. Choose one. Stick with it for 90 days.
